sermon.title: The Second Time Jesus Spoke: His Objective 03/31/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the second time Jesus spoke, at His baptism: “it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Because God made us free to choose, it was only right that He make a way back. Jesus fulfilled all righteousness to guarantee us the right to be born of the Spirit, filled with power, tested for endurance, and grown into the divine nature.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.answer: He sees that, but it isn’t real repentance.

faqs.question: What does mankind need to hear?
faqs.answer: What Jesus says, not church doctrine.

faqs.question: What does a virgin bride picture?
faqs.answer: A bride with no sexual relationships.

faqs.question: What does he say about permissive rights?
faqs.answer: They let people commit sin he names.

faqs.question: What moved him to get saved?
Is the Spirit just a feeling?
faqs.answer: No; it drives us into truth.
